stories.headline: Tom Laperche wins the Route du Rhum in record time
stories.summary: The French sailor Tom Laperche has won the Route du Rhum, the single-handed yacht race that runs from Saint Malo in Brittany to Guadeloupe in the Caribbean. He crossed the finish line on 7 November in a record six days, 13 hours, 27 minutes and 40 seconds. That is six hours and 19 minutes faster than the time Charles Caudrelier set in 2022.

stories.headline: Kyle Larson takes a third NASCAR Cup Series title
stories.summary: Kyle Larson of Hendrick Motorsports has won his third NASCAR Cup Series championship, and his second in a row. He clinched the title at the season finale, after winning three races in the Chase. He is the first back-to-back champion since Jimmie Johnson in 2009 and 2010.

stories.headline: Strange gas hints at hidden volcanic activity on Mars
stories.summary: An international team has found unusual concentrations of hydrogen chloride gas above fractures in the Alba Mons volcanic region of Mars. They think the gas may be rising from hot magma underground, which would mean Mars still has dormant volcanic systems. On Earth the same gas is frequently released through openings connected to magma.
